ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
